name: Gae Bolg
description: A lance shaped for those who meet danger in the open sky. Its three forms trace a Dragoon’s passage from practiced leaps to the resolve of a legend.

name: Excalibur
description: An oath given an edge: a Paladin’s blade that carries the promise to stand between danger and those who cannot stand alone.

name: Apocalypse
description: A blade from the edge of fallen kingdoms. Its path asks a Dark Knight to command the shadows without surrendering to them.

name: Godhand
description: An expression of the Monk’s relentless discipline. Each stage refines a weapon meant to follow the speed and purpose of its wielder.

name: Masamune
description: A blade spoken of in the quietest dueling halls. Every stage reflects the Samurai’s search for precision, patience, and a decisive strike.

name: Stardust Rod
description: A staff imagined from the embers of distant stars. Its growing radiance mirrors the Black Mage’s command of dangerous arcane power.

name: Nirvana
description: A staff that honors the hands that heal after battle. Its awakening reflects a White Mage’s patience, courage, and steady light.

name: Last Knife
description: A compact weapon with a far-reaching reputation. In a Thief’s hands, its finest edge is timing rather than size.

name: Bravura
description: An axe built for the Warrior who presses onward when the battle turns grim. Each form records another test of endurance.

name: Murgleis
description: An elegant duelist’s weapon, poised between blade-work and spellcraft. Its three stages follow the Red Mage’s pursuit of balance.

name: Yoshimitsu
description: A weapon for the practiced shadow. Its refinement rewards a Ninja’s restraint, speed, and the wisdom to strike unseen.

name: Veil of Wiyu
description: An ancient tome whose pages are marked with names from beyond the veil. Its growing resonance reflects the Summoner’s bond with otherworldly allies.

name: Almace
description: A blade for the restless student of monsters and magic. Its evolution mirrors the Blue Mage’s habit of turning every encounter into a lesson.

name: Chronos
description: A curious relic marked with circles and fragments of old calendars. Its three forms recall a Time Mage’s study of the space between moments.

name: Artemis Bow
description: A bow that seems to hum before the arrow flies. Its awakening follows the Bard’s rhythm through danger, memory, and triumph.

name: Armageddon
description: A formidable instrument of invention and precision. Its changing form reflects the Machinist’s conviction that ingenuity belongs on the battlefield.

name: Guttler
description: A rugged weapon worn smooth by the wilderness. Each stage honors the Beastmaster’s understanding of creatures both fierce and familiar.

name: Astral Codex
description: A scholar’s armament written in star charts and careful calculations. Its evolution follows the Sage’s path from observation to mastery.

name: Gae Bolg Infinity
description: A new Ultimate Relic for the Dragoon, beginning at character Lv.90 after mastering Gae Bolg. Ascend through the forgotten sky realms and challenge the Eclipse Sovereign to attain the Eternal form.
